acceptance: With cancelled intermediate runs, trunk-status names the commit that introduced the failure, or starts a run that determines it; a test covers the cancelled-range case.
description: Trunk runs are now one at a time (#3834), so intermediate develop pushes get cancelled. When #3836 broke develop its own trunk run was cancelled, and make trunk-status first named #3834 (the commit whose run failed) as the culprit, then 'one of 11 commits'. trunk-revert then offers either the wrong revert or none, leaving only owner fix-forward. Re-run trunk on the earliest uncovered commit, bisect the cancelled range, or let a revert of any covered commit that makes the failing test pass reopen arming.
